audience: delivery and field-service dispatchers who plan driver routes in Upper Route Planner

useCases.title: Find stops that are not on a route yet
useCases.text: The AI lists the stops that no route holds, with address, time window and service duration. You see what still needs planning.

useCases.title: Review the stops of one route
useCases.text: The AI lists the stops of a route in optimized order with address, contact, time window and status.

useCases.title: Set up tomorrow's route from a list of addresses
useCases.text: Give a route name, a date and the addresses. The AI creates the route and adds each address as a stop for Upper to geocode.

useCases.title: Assign drivers, optimize and wait for the result
useCases.text: The AI assigns drivers to a route, starts the optimization of its stop order and polls until the route shows as optimized.

useCases.title: Move or correct a stop
useCases.text: The AI changes the address, time window or route of an existing stop. A stop on an optimized route flags that route for a new optimization.

useCases.title: Send a finished route to the drivers' app
useCases.text: After you confirm, the AI pushes the route to the drivers' mobile app, which notifies each assigned driver.
